env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos run .
stdout '^1 <nil>$'
stdout '^\{2 <nil>\}$'
stdout '^7 <nil>$'
stdout '^42 <nil>$'
stdout '^9 <nil>$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/tuples

go 1.27

-- main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/tuples/pair"
)

func main() {
	a, b := pair.V
	fmt.Println(a, b)
	t := pair.Make(2)
	fmt.Println(t)
	n := pair.Named(7)
	fmt.Println(n.id, n.err)
	fmt.Println(pair.Show((42, nil)))
	fmt.Println(pair.Show(t))
	var mine (id int64, err error) = (9, nil)
	fmt.Println(pair.Show(mine))
}

-- pair/pair.lgo --
package pair

import "fmt"

var V (id int64, err error) = (1, nil)

func Make(v int64) (id int64, err error) {
	return v, nil
}

func Named(x int) (id int64, err error) {
	return int64(x), nil
}

func Show(t (id int64, err error)) string {
	a, b := t
	return fmt.Sprint(a, b)
}
